_comment: Repository-level configuration for documentation tools. Maps topic names to folder paths and declares conventions.
_comment_consumers: This file is a reference for sessions that need to build a FileUpdatePackage: it says what the topic folders are called, so a manifest can carry correct relative paths. The tools do NOT read it - version cleanup, the binder builder and the file update package deployer each have their own settings file beside their own script.
_comment_topic_folders: Topic name -> folder path, relative to the documentation root. These are the folders that hold master documents. Everything else at the root is underscore-prefixed machinery.
_comment_superseded_folder: Superseded documents are moved into a folder of this name inside the folder they came from. Note the spelling: an incorrectly spelled _superceded folder exists at the documentation root and is deliberately left alone. Never create another one.
_comment_fileupdatepackages_folder: Where FileUpdatePackages are dropped to be deployed, relative to the documentation root.
